key.name: lock-shortcut
key.summary: Kill switch: lock pcbridge desktop control
key.description: Runs `pcbridge lock`, like the panel menu's "Lock desktop control now". Example: ['<Super><Control>Escape'].

key.name: indicator-mode
key.summary: When the panel icon is shown
key.description: "always", or "when-granted": hidden while desktop control is closed. While desktop control is granted the icon is shown in either mode. pcbridge's panel_icon tool sets this.
